column1: # Sampleworks checkpoints image: every file, its upstream source and its sha256.
# fetch.sh downloads each URL, refuses any file whose sha256 does not match, and
# lays it out under /checkpoints/<dest>. A `.tar` dest is extracted into
# /checkpoints instead of kept. Keep in sync with the COPY lines and the guard in
# HuggingFace URLs are pinned to a commit, and their sha256 is the LFS oid the
# HuggingFace API reports for that commit. RF3 and Protenix publish no
# checksum; their sha256 was computed from the upstream file on 2026-11-20.
# RF3: the image keeps the historical filename, but the content is the
